title: ConTra: A Training Framework for Effective Contextual Retrieval via Prefix Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.34366v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data management systems organize large text collections for tasks such as finding relevant studies and extracting contract clauses. Systems make long documents searchable by splitting them into independently indexed chunks. Chunking can separate text from its identifying details. The indexing challenge is to keep each chunk independently searchable while preserving the context needed to find and rank it. Existing methods either encode that context in chunk vectors or attach it as a text prefix. Context encoded only in vectors is unavailable to text rerankers. Prompted prefixes serve both vector search and reranking, but are costly to generate at indexing time and can underperform contextual encoders. We propose ConTra (Context That Travels), a reinforcement learning framework for training lightweight prefix generators. Its reward combines feedback from frozen embedding and reranking models with factual verification and length control.

translated_title: ConTra：一种通过前缀生成实现高效上下文检索的训练框架
translated_abstract: 数据管理系统为诸如查找相关研究和提取合同条款等任务组织大规模文本集合。系统通过将长文档切分为可独立索引的块，使其变得可检索。分块可能会将文本与其标识性细节分离。索引方面的挑战在于，既要保持每个块可独立检索，又要保留查找和排序该块所需的上下文。现有方法要么将该上下文编码到块向量中，要么将其作为文本前缀附加。仅编码在向量中的上下文对文本重排序器是不可用的；基于提示生成的前缀虽可同时服务于向量搜索和重排序，但在索引阶段生成成本高昂，且性能可能不及上下文编码器。我们提出ConTra（Context That Travels，即“可传递的上下文”），一个用于训练轻量级前缀生成器的强化学习框架。其奖励函数将冻结的嵌入模型与重排序模型的反馈同事实校验和长度控制相结合。
tldr: ConTra提出了一种强化学习训练框架，通过训练轻量级前缀生成器为文档分块生成上下文前缀，使上下文同时服务于向量检索与文本重排序，并显著降低索引阶段的生成成本。
en_tdlr: ConTra is a reinforcement learning framework that trains lightweight prefix generators to attach contextual prefixes to document chunks, enabling the context to serve both vector search and text reranking while significantly reducing indexing-time generation cost.
